claim: The AWS database decision guide describes Amazon MemoryDB as an in-memory database with full data persistence and sub-millisecond read latencies, suitable as a high-performance primary database, with Multi-AZ durability.
question: Which in-memory service does the decision guide say is durable enough to be a primary database?

values.display: full data persistence with sub-millisecond read latencies

qualifiers.scope: AWS database decision guide, Choose section
